stories.headline: Microsoft to deploy AMD's Helios rack-scale AI system on Azure as Nvidia challenge ships in 2H 2026

key_facts.fact: AMD and Microsoft announced an expanded strategic partnership on July 20, 2026, under which Microsoft will deploy the AMD Helios rack-scale platform on Azure to power frontier-model AI inference for Microsoft, its AI customers and Azure AI services.
key_facts.excerpt: AMD and Microsoft announced an expanded strategic partnership on July 20, 2026... Microsoft will deploy the AMD Helios Rackscale Solution to power frontier model AI inference for Microsoft, its AI customers, and Azure AI services.

key_facts.fact: AMD said it will begin shipping Helios to customers, including Microsoft, in the second half of 2026.
key_facts.excerpt: AMD said it will begin shipping Helios to customers, including Microsoft, in the second half of 2026.

key_facts.fact: The Helios rack-scale design integrates 72 AMD Instinct MI455X GPUs with AMD EPYC 'Venice' CPUs and AMD Pensando 'Vulcano' networking (UALink), built on Meta's Open Rack Wide (ORW) form factor submitted to the Open Compute Project.
key_facts.excerpt: The AMD Helios rackscale design integrates 72 AMD Instinct MI455X GPUs with AMD EPYC 'Venice' CPUs and AMD Pensando 'Vulcano' networking using UALink... the first full rack built on ORW standards.

key_facts.fact: Each MI455X GPU carries 432 GB of HBM4 memory with up to 19.6 TB/s of bandwidth.
key_facts.excerpt: Instinct MI455X GPU uses next-gen the AMD CDNA... with 432 GB HBM4 of memory and up to 19.6 TB/s bandwidth.

key_facts.fact: Azure will also add two new VM series on 6th Gen AMD EPYC 'Venice' processors: HDv2 for agentic AI and data pipelines, and HXv2 for semiconductor design workloads.
key_facts.excerpt: Azure will also add two new VM series powered by 6th Gen AMD EPYC 'Venice' processors. The Azure HDv2 series is targeted at agentic AI and data pipelines, while the Azure HXv2 series is aimed at semiconductor design workloads.

key_facts.fact: Microsoft joins Meta, OpenAI, Oracle and Tata Consultancy Services in committing to Helios; Meta said in February it would use up to 6 gigawatts of AMD GPUs over time, starting with 1 gigawatt on Helios racks later this year.
key_facts.excerpt: Microsoft announced Monday it will use the Helios system in its data centers, joining Meta, OpenAI, Oracle and others... In February, Meta announced it'll use up to 6 gigawatts of AMD GPUs over time, starting with 1 gigawatt deployed on Helios racks later this year.

stories.headline: TSMC CFO says it will accelerate Arizona buildout as 2nm drives Q3 revenue and first US fab matches Taiwan yields

key_facts.fact: TSMC CFO Wendell Huang told CNBC the company will accelerate its Arizona expansion amid a 'multi-year demand mega trend,' with its additional $100 billion commitment lifting total Arizona investment to $265 billion.
key_facts.excerpt: TSMC is racing to accelerate capacity at its Arizona factory as the company continues to see a 'multi-year demand mega trend'... The fresh commitment raises TSMC's total investment pipeline in Arizona to $265 billion.

key_facts.fact: Huang framed TSMC's 2-nanometer technology as the newest revenue driver heading into the third quarter, following its initial revenue generation in the second quarter.
key_facts.excerpt: framing the 2-nanometer technology as the company's newest revenue driver heading into the third quarter, following its initial revenue generation in second quarter.

key_facts.fact: TSMC's first Arizona fab is operational and achieving yields 'as good as' its flagship fab in Taiwan; the second fab will shortly begin moving in equipment and a third is under construction, with a fourth fab and first advanced-packaging facility in preparation.
key_facts.excerpt: TSMC's first Arizona fabrication plant... is operational and achieving yields 'as good as' the flagship fab in Taiwan... The second fab will shortly begin moving in equipment, while construction of a third fab is under way and preparatory work has started on a fourth fab and the site's first advanced packaging facility.

key_facts.fact: Huang flagged a shortage of construction workers in Arizona as a physical constraint on the buildout, which TSMC will work with the US government to solve.
key_facts.excerpt: 'there are physical constraints — the number of construction workers available, the infrastructures available,' Huang said. 'We'll work closely with the government to solve these issues.'

key_facts.fact: The $100 billion pledge, announced July 16 after record Q2 results, also fueled an upward revision of TSMC's full-year 2026 capital expenditure to between $60 billion and $64 billion.
key_facts.excerpt: a massive AI-driven capacity build-out that also fueled an upward revision to the company's full-year capital expenditure to between $60 billion and $64 billion.

stories.headline: Blackstone buys control of Korea's Futronic, valuing the robot-actuator maker at about $676M

key_facts.fact: Blackstone announced on July 20, 2026 that its private equity fund signed a deal to acquire equity in Futronic, a leading South Korean supplier of high-precision actuators for the automotive and industrial robotics industries.
key_facts.excerpt: investment in FUTRONIC... a leading supplier of high-precision actuators serving the global automotive and industrial robotics industries. This transaction is in partnership with FUTRONIC's Founder, Jin-ho Ko, who will remain in his role as Chairman and Chief Executive Officer.

key_facts.fact: The transaction values Futronic at about 1 trillion Korean won, or roughly $676 million, according to a person familiar with the matter cited by Reuters; Blackstone did not disclose the investment size or stake.
key_facts.excerpt: a transaction that values the company at about ₩1 Tn, or $676 Mn, according to a person with knowledge of the matter cited by Reuters... Blackstone did not disclose the size of the investment or the stake it would acquire.

key_facts.fact: Yonhap reported that Blackstone would acquire more than half of Futronic, while founder Jin-ho Ko would remain the second-largest shareholder and stay on as chairman and CEO.
key_facts.excerpt: South Korea's Yonhap News Agency reported that the investment firm would acquire more than half the company, while founder Jin-ho Ko would remain its second-largest shareholder.

key_facts.fact: Founded in 1993, Futronic supplies motion-control components to global automotive OEMs and is expanding into humanoids and general robotics; it recorded 175.6 billion won in sales and 41.9 billion won in operating profit last year, an operating margin around 20%.
key_facts.excerpt: Founded in 1993, Putronic focuses on key parts of automotive electrical equipment... now expanding its business beyond the automobile industry to humanoids and general-purpose robotics... it recorded 175.6 billion won in sales and 41.9 billion won in operating profit. Based on barriers to entry into technology, it has a high operating margin of around 20%.

key_facts.fact: Blackstone, which manages more than $1.3 trillion in assets, framed the deal as a bet that the actuator components inside robots are where durable margins sit as AI converges with the physical world.
key_facts.excerpt: Blackstone has been buying up suppliers of unglamorous but essential components... and it has more than $1.3 trillion under management to do it with... the components layer of the industry, rather than the finished robots, is where durable margins hide.

stories.headline: China's Zhongji Innolight launches order-gauging for up to $8B Hong Kong listing, city's biggest since Alibaba

key_facts.fact: Zhongji Innolight, the Shenzhen-listed maker of optical transceivers essential to data-center buildout, began gauging investor demand for a Hong Kong listing and started analyst meetings from Monday, July 20, 2026, aiming to raise as much as $8 billion.
key_facts.excerpt: The Shenzhen-listed maker of optical transceivers essential to data centre build-out may start taking investor orders as soon as the week of Jul 20 to raise as much as US$8 billion... The company is starting analyst meetings with investors from Monday (Jul 20).

key_facts.fact: At $8 billion, the listing would be Hong Kong's largest first-time share sale since Alibaba's $12.9 billion listing in 2019.
key_facts.excerpt: At US$8 billion, Innolight's listing would be Hong Kong's biggest since Alibaba Group Holding's US$12.9 billion listing in 2019.

key_facts.fact: Zhongji Innolight shares surged as much as 8% on Monday, July 20, after receiving approval for the Hong Kong listing on Friday, July 18; the deal would exceed Luxshare Precision's $3.1 billion IPO earlier in July to become Hong Kong's largest listing of 2026.
key_facts.excerpt: Shares of China's Zhongji Innolight surged as much as 8% Monday before paring some gains, after the company received approval for a major Hong Kong listing worth up to $8 billion on Friday... The deal size will exceed Luxshare Precision's $3.1 billion IPO earlier this month, making it the largest listing in Hong Kong this year.

key_facts.fact: Goldman Sachs, China International Capital Corp, Morgan Stanley and GF Securities are leading the listing, with Haitong International, Citigroup, HSBC and China Galaxy Securities also working on the deal.
key_facts.excerpt: Goldman Sachs Group, China International Capital, Morgan Stanley and GF Securities are leading Innolight's listing. Haitong International Securities, Citigroup, HSBC Holdings and China Galaxy Securities are also working on the deal.

key_facts.fact: The company filed confidentially with Hong Kong's exchange in April 2026 targeting about $3 billion; the target more than doubled to as much as $8 billion by the time it cleared its listing hearing on July 17.
key_facts.excerpt: Zhongji Innolight, already listed on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange under ticker 300308.SZ, filed confidentially with Hong Kong's exchange back in April 2026. The initial target was a more modest $3 billion raise... Somewhere between filing and clearing, the deal size more than doubled.

stories.headline: Google is designing 'Frozen v2' server chip with Gemini baked into silicon for 2028, report says

key_facts.fact: The Information reported that Google is developing a custom server chip informally known as 'Frozen v2' that hardwires parts of its Gemini AI model directly into the silicon, with deployment targeted as early as 2028.
key_facts.excerpt: According to The Information, the new chip is informally known as Frozen v2 and is being developed as part of Google's efforts to more tightly integrate its AI software and underlying hardware infrastructure... Google reportedly plans to deploy the chip as early as 2028.

key_facts.fact: Frozen v2 could reportedly deliver six to 10 times greater efficiency than Google's latest custom AI chips, measured by the number of AI tokens served per unit of power consumed.
key_facts.excerpt: Frozen v2 could reportedly deliver six to 10 times greater efficiency than Google's latest custom AI chips when measured by the number of AI tokens served for each unit of power consumed.

key_facts.fact: The Frozen project is intended to create a separate family of custom chips that supplements Google's existing Tensor Processing Units (TPUs) rather than replacing them, specifically optimized for serving Gemini inference.
key_facts.excerpt: The purpose of the Frozen project is not about replacing the TPUs that Google uses but rather supplementing them with another family of custom AI chips that would be designed specifically to support Gemini's inference.

key_facts.fact: The chip aims to ease a compute and electricity squeeze at Google serious enough that Google Cloud has declined some deals with outside customers; engineers are still finalizing the design and how much model information to hardwire.
key_facts.excerpt: The Information says Alphabet is hitting a compute and electricity squeeze serious enough that Google Cloud has declined some deals with outside customers. Frozen v2 aims to help by embedding some model knowledge directly into a dedicated chip.

stories.headline: Amentum picked by US Energy Department to build 1-GW AI data center with 2 GW of on-site power

key_facts.fact: On July 20, 2026, Amentum (NYSE: AMTM) said it was selected by the US Department of Energy's National Nuclear Security Administration (NNSA) to enter negotiations for a phased lease to develop one of the nation's largest integrated AI and energy projects at the Savannah River Site in South Carolina.
key_facts.excerpt: Amentum (NYSE: AMTM) has been selected by the U.S. Department of Energy's National Nuclear Security Administration (NNSA) to enter negotiations for a phased lease to develop one of the nation's largest integrated artificial intelligence and energy infrastructure projects at the Savannah River Site (SRS) in South Carolina.

key_facts.fact: Once finalized, the public-private project would establish a 1-gigawatt AI data center supported by approximately 2 gigawatts of on-site energy generation, initially powered by natural gas bridging to advanced nuclear energy.
key_facts.excerpt: the public-private project would establish a 1-gigawatt artificial intelligence data center supported by approximately 2 gigawatts of on-site energy generation, initially powered by natural gas bridging to advanced nuclear energy.

key_facts.fact: Amentum shares rose about 5.7% pre-market on Monday, July 20 following the selection.
key_facts.excerpt: Amentum (AMTM) up 5.7% pre-market Monday after saying it was selected by the U.S. Department of Energy's National Nuclear Security Administration to enter negotiations for a phased lease.

key_facts.fact: The Savannah River Site is one of four DOE sites identified for AI infrastructure projects on federal land; NNSA had issued its request for proposals in September 2025 seeking bids by December 5, 2025.
key_facts.excerpt: Savannah River Site is one of four sites identified by the Department of Energy (DOE) for AI infrastructure and generation projects on federal land... On September 30, NNSA has issued a Request for Proposals seeking proposals by December 5, 2025.
